newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee end steady in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee end steady in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady at 41.40 to the dollar on Thursday on slightly higher demand of the U.S. currency and dealers said the rupee would maintain these levels in the coming days.
"The dollar demand has slightly picked up, but rupee will remain stable as the supply of U.S. currency is strong," dealer Owais Kalia said.

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, fixed on June 28, was at 40.4600/40.6623 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates finished at 2.30 percent from 2.45 in the previous session.
